rules.rule: Never changes or removes a set key, its value, or any other line
must: Never\ change\ or\ remove\ a\ key\ the\ file\ sets,\ its\ value,\ or\ any\ other\ line

rules.rule: Server keys are kept as found and written only into a new file
must: keep\ `mcp\-server`,\ `mcp\-port`,\ `watch`,\ and\ `watch\-debounce`\ as\ found,\ and\ write\ them\ only\ into\ a\ new\ file

rules.rule: One proposal of the whole front matter, then one question
must: Propose\ once:\ the\ whole\ front\ matter\ as\ it\ will\ be
Ask\ one\ question:\ write\ it\ as\ shown,\ or\ which\ values\ to\ change

rules.rule: A required key not found blocks the write, even after a yes
must: still\s+`not\ found`\ blocks\ the\ write\.\ After\ the\ user\ answers\ step\ 4,\ even\ with\ a\s+yes

rules.rule: Skips the gate and calls no server tool
must: Skip\ the\ gate
Call\ no\ server\ tool,\ start\ no\ server,\ and\ never\ touch\ `\.mcp\.json`

rules.rule: Terse report
must: Report\ tersely:\ no\ preamble\ or\ narration

rules.rule: The key reference is copied verbatim and appended once
must: Copy\ \[assets/keys\.md\]\(assets/keys\.md\)\ verbatim,\ never\ reworded
Skip\ it\ when\ the\ body\ already\ has\ a\ `\#\#\ Front\ matter\ keys`\ heading\ or\ a\ table\ row\ naming\ `mcp\-server`

rules.rule: check writes nothing, fixes nothing, and calls only read tools
must: `check`\ is\ read\-only:\ it\ writes\ nothing\ and\ fixes\ nothing\ in\ the\ project

rules.rule: check never stops at the first problem; without a server it reports and continues
must: Run\ every\ check\ below;\ never\ stop\ at\ the\ first\ problem\.
report\ it\ as\ a\ problem,\ and\ report\ the\ lines\ that\ need\ the\ server\ as\ `not\ checked`

rules.rule: counts are read off the server's answers
must: Read\ every\ count\ off\ the\ server's\ answers,\ never\ estimate\ one\.

rules.rule: Names the docket plugin as the writer of the server keys
must: the\ docket\ plugin\ writes\ a\ starter\ config

rules.rule: A file without mcp-server or sources is not set up; the proposal notes it and never adds the key
must: An\ existing\ file\ without\ `mcp\-server`\ or\ `sources`\ is\ not\ set\ up
\|\ `mcp\-server`\ missing

rules.rule: Each missing required key is asked in turn; the last answer is the confirmation and the file is written at once
must: ask\ for\ each\ such\ value\ in\ turn,\ one\ question\ per\ message
the\ answers\ are\ the\ confirmation,\ even\ though\ the\ front\s+matter\ now\ differs

rules.rule: srd-work: none counts as set; the proposal offers none
must: `none`\ counts\ as\ set
answer\ `none`\ to\ keep\ working\ files\ beside\ each\ SRD

rules.rule: The key reference lists only the working-file kinds the skills write
must: Folder\ for\ SRD\ working\ files\ \(`review`,\ `decisions`,\ `questions`\)

rules.rule: The missing-mcp-server note sits above the yaml block, never inside it
must: a\ note\ above\ the\ `yaml`\ block,\ never\ inside\ it

rules.rule: gaps is always proposed as gap; no candidate search
must: \|\ `gaps`\ +\|\ always\ `gap`

rules.rule: With every key set, a missing kb, gaps, or srd-work folder is proposed as a .gitkeep, not reported as set up
must: one\ line\ per\ folder\ `kb`,\ `gaps`,\ or\ `srd\-work`\ names\ that\s+does\ not\ exist

rules.rule: A missing sources key gets a note, not a written key
must: "`sources`\ is\ not\ set:\ add\ your\ doc\ folders\ and\ `kb`\ yourself

rules.rule: kb, set before or added now, is added to a set sources that lacks it
must: `kb`\ added\ to\ `sources`,\ when\ `sources`\ is\ set\ and\ lacks\ it

rules.rule: One <dir> per run; a second directory is a leftover word, not recognized
must: `check`\s+may stand anywhere; the other token is `<dir>`, one per run
